authority.source_authority: Current main supplies repository policy; immutable commit eaf31a940d3166b49c38ca26eb279392e0a3b25b is the sole M7 publication source. Lowell retains release and merge authority.

non_overlap_statement: Only root-publication-writer may edit T611; all worker and checker roles are read-only, may not delegate, and may not access M8.

roles.why_needed: One accountable writer must integrate the publication contract, deterministic builder, documentation, tests, and handoff without touching protected lanes.
roles.mission: Build the smallest honest public M7 candidate publication surface and reproducible content-addressed package from the immutable source commit.
inputs: Lowell's T611 publication and M8-isolation instructions
roles.authority: May write only C:/wt/logos-t611-m7-publication and may publish a draft PR/release; may not merge or publish a final release without Lowell's separate gate.
acceptance_conditions: Progress measures separate 66/66 strategy/map coverage from 22/66 corrective rereview.
The package is built only from allowlisted Git objects at the pinned source commit and has a reproducible SHA-256.
M8 is neither accessed nor modified and convergence remains deferred.
Repository, handoff, privacy, schema, package, and focused tests pass.
stop_conditions: An intended artifact is absent from the immutable source commit.
License or privacy authority is insufficient for an included object.
The task would require M8 access, dirty-M7 access, merge authority, or final release approval.

readiness_conditions: Writer validations pass on the frozen diff and built package.

roles.why_needed: The source commit contains thousands of mixed-quality M7 objects and its coverage claims require independent deterministic reconstruction.
roles.mission: Inventory immutable M7 Git objects, derive counts and hashes, and distinguish observed evidence from plans, aliases, superseded evidence, and unqualified claims.
inputs: Git tree and blobs at eaf31a940d3166b49c38ca26eb279392e0a3b25b
roles.authority: Read-only Git-object inspection; no filesystem writes, dirty-lane reads, M8 access, publication approval, or delegation.
acceptance_conditions: Counts, paths, and limitations are supported by exact Git-object evidence.
The report identifies suitable PR metadata and release-package evidence.
stop_conditions: A requested fact requires working-tree-only or M8 evidence.
The source commit is unavailable or changes identity.

readiness_conditions: All reported claims cite immutable paths and commands.

roles.why_needed: A public artifact can expose paths, runtime debris, source text, or unclear-license material even when it is already present in Git history.
roles.mission: Classify immutable M7 objects under a default-deny public release boundary and identify privacy, provenance, license, duplication, and absent-module hazards.
inputs: Git tree and blobs at eaf31a940d3166b49c38ca26eb279392e0a3b25b
roles.authority: Read-only classification; cannot authorize publication, infer rights, edit files, access M8, or delegate.
acceptance_conditions: Every proposed artifact class is public, dual, hold, or exclude with evidence.
Blocking and residual risks are explicit.
stop_conditions: Publication authority or provenance is ambiguous for a proposed payload.
Review would require private, dirty-working-tree, or M8 content.

readiness_conditions: Evidence pointers and unresolved holds are recorded.

roles.why_needed: The author cannot independently approve a public-facing, hash-bound release surface.
roles.mission: Rebuild and inspect the frozen candidate, replay deterministic checks, red-team false authority and privacy leakage, and issue a merge/release gate.
inputs: worker evidence and deterministic validation logs
roles.authority: Read-only independent review; cannot edit, push, merge, publish a final release, inspect M8, or self-author evidence.
acceptance_conditions: Source pin, allowlist, hashes, counts, privacy, licensing, qualifications, and M8 isolation are independently verified.
The checker reports PASS or exact blocking findings with replay commands.
stop_conditions: The candidate changes after its review snapshot.
Required evidence is missing or the checker would need prohibited data.

readiness_conditions: Writer checks pass and the candidate diff/package are frozen.

proof_obligations.description: Prove every release-package payload is an allowlisted blob from the pinned M7 commit.
evidence_required: per-file Git blob IDs and SHA-256 values
negative test for absent or unallowlisted paths

proof_obligations.description: Keep strategy coverage, candidate-map coverage, corrective depth, replay qualification, and release qualification separate.
Exclude runtime debris, private paths, copied corpora, unclear-license material, defective untracked artifacts, and unusable tests.
Prove T611 neither reads nor mutates M8 and defers comparison until a separately frozen M8 publication exists.
evidence_required: convergence gate with missing M8 freeze

unresolved_decisions.summary: Final GitHub release publication and PR merge remain Lowell-owned gates after independent review.
